celaleyn:62-62.t: ﴿سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. Allah established that as a practice ﴿فِي الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ among the past nations, concerning their hypocrites who spread alarming rumours among the believers ﴿وَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا﴾ from Him.

celaleyn:63-63.t: ﴿يَسْأَلُكَ النَّاسُ﴾ i.e. the people of Mecca ﴿عَنِ السَّاعَةِ﴾ when it will be ﴿قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ﴾ informs you of it, i.e. you do not know it ﴿لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ تَكُونُ﴾ comes into being ﴿قَرِيبًا﴾

celaleyn:64-64.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَنَ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾ He has removed them far away ﴿وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ سَعِيرًا﴾ an intense fire which they will enter

celaleyn:65-65.t: ﴿خَالِدِينَ﴾ their abiding forever having been decreed (muqaddar) ﴿فِيهَا أَبَدًا لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا﴾ who would protect them from it ﴿وَلَا نَصِيرًا﴾ who would repel it from them

celaleyn:66-66.t: ﴿يَوْمَ تُقَلَّبُ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ يَقُولُونَ يَا﴾ for drawing attention (tanbīh) ﴿لَيْتَنَا أَطَعْنَا اللَّهَ وَأَطَعْنَا الرَّسُولَا﴾

celaleyn:67-67.t: ﴿وَقَالُوا﴾ i.e. the followers among them ﴿رَبَّنَا إِنَّا أَطَعْنَا سَادَتَنَا﴾ and in one reading [سَادَاتَنَا], the plural of a plural ﴿وَكُبَرَاءَنَا فَأَضَلُّونَا السَّبِيلَا﴾ the path of guidance

celaleyn:68-68.t: ﴿رَبَّنَا آتِهِمْ ضِعْفَيْنِ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ﴾ i.e. twice our punishment ﴿وَالْعَنْهُمْ﴾ punish them ﴿لَعْنًا كَثِيرًا﴾ many in number; and in one reading with the single-dotted letter (bāʾ) [كَبِيرًا], i.e. great

celaleyn:69-69.t: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَكُونُوا﴾ with your Prophet ﴿كَالَّذِينَ آذَوْا مُوسَى﴾ by their saying, for example, "Nothing prevents him from bathing with us except that he has a scrotal swelling (ādar)" ﴿فَبَرَّأَهُ اللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُوا﴾ in that he put his garment on a rock in order to bathe, and the rock fled with it until it stopped among an assembly of the Children of Israel; Moses caught up with it, took his garment and covered himself with it, and they saw that he had no udra, which is a swelling in the testicle ﴿وَكَانَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَجِيهًا﴾ possessing high standing. Among the things by which our Prophet ﷺ was hurt is that he made a distribution, and a man said, "This is a distribution by which the Face of Allah the Exalted was not intended." The Prophet ﷺ became angry at that and said: "May Allah have mercy on Moses; he was hurt with more than this and was patient." Al-Bukhārī narrated it.

celaleyn:70-70.t: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا﴾ correct

celaleyn:71-71.t: ﴿يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ﴾ He will accept them ﴿وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا﴾ he has attained the utmost of what he seeks

celaleyn:72-72.t: ﴿إِنَّا عَرَضْنَا الْأَمَانَةَ﴾ the prayers and other things, with the reward that lies in doing them and the punishment in abandoning them ﴿عَلَى السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالْجِبَالِ﴾ in that He created in them understanding and speech ﴿فَأَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَحْمِلْنَهَا وَأَشْفَقْنَ﴾ they feared ﴿مِنْهَا وَحَمَلَهَا الْإِنْسَانُ﴾ Adam, after it had been offered to him ﴿إِنَّهُ كَانَ ظَلُومًا﴾ to himself, by what he took on ﴿جَهُولًا﴾ of it

celaleyn:73-73.t: ﴿لِيُعَذِّبَ اللَّهُ﴾ the lām is attached (mutaʿalliq) to «عَرَضْنَا», upon which Adam's bearing [of the trust] followed ﴿الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكَاتِ﴾ who squander the trust ﴿وَيَتُوبَ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ﴾ who discharge the trust ﴿وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا﴾ to the believers ﴿رَحِيمًا﴾ towards them.

celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ﴾ persist in fearing Him, ﴿وَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ﴾ in what contradicts your Sacred Law; ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا﴾ of what will be before it comes to be, ﴿حَكِيمًا﴾ in what He creates.

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿وَاتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ i.e. the Qurʾān; ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا﴾ — and in one reading [تَعْمَلُونَ], with the dotted-above letter (tāʾ).

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ in your affair; ﴿وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا﴾ as a guardian for you. His community follows him in all of that.

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿مَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَيْنِ فِي جَوْفِهِ﴾ as a rebuttal of one of the unbelievers who said that he had two hearts, with each of which he understood better than Muḥammad's understanding; ﴿وَمَا جَعَلَ أَزْوَاجَكُمُ اللَّائِي﴾ read with hamza and yāʾ, and without yāʾ, ﴿تَظَّهَّرُونَ﴾ read without an alif before the hāʾ and with it, the second tāʾ of the underlying form being assimilated into the ẓāʾ [تُظَاهِرُونَ] ﴿مِنْهُنَّ﴾ — one of them says, for example, to his wife: «you are to me like my mother's back» — ﴿أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ﴾ i.e. like mothers in her being made unlawful by that, which in the Jāhiliyya was counted as divorce; rather, expiation (kaffāra) becomes due by it, under its condition, as is mentioned in Sūrat al-Mujādila. ﴿وَمَا جَعَلَ أَدْعِيَاءَكُمْ﴾ the plural of daʿiyy, who is one called the son of someone other than his father, ﴿أَبْنَاءَكُمْ﴾ in reality; ﴿ذَلِكُمْ قَوْلُكُمْ بِأَفْوَاهِكُمْ﴾ i.e. of the Jews and the hypocrites: when the Prophet ﷺ married Zaynab bint Jaḥsh, who had been the wife of Zayd ibn Ḥāritha, whom the Prophet ﷺ had adopted, they said: Muḥammad has married his son's wife; and Allah the Exalted gave them the lie in that. ﴿وَاللَّهُ يَقُولُ الْحَقَّ﴾ in that, ﴿وَهُوَ يَهْدِي السَّبِيلَ﴾ the path of truth; but [rather]:

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿ادْعُوهُمْ لِآبَائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ﴾ more just ﴿عِنْدَ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا آبَاءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَمَوَالِيكُمْ﴾ your cousins; ﴿وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا أَخْطَأْتُمْ بِهِ﴾ in that, ﴿وَلَكِنْ﴾ in ﴿مَا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ﴾ in it — that is, after the prohibition; ﴿وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا﴾ of what you said before the prohibition, ﴿رَحِيمًا﴾ to you in that.

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿النَّبِيُّ أَوْلَى بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ in what he calls them to while their own selves call them to the opposite; ﴿وَأَزْوَاجُهُ أُمَّهَاتُهُمْ﴾ in the unlawfulness for them of marrying them; ﴿وَأُولُوا الْأَرْحَامِ﴾ those related by kinship ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَى بِبَعْضٍ﴾ in inheritance ﴿فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ﴾ i.e. than inheritance by faith and emigration, which existed at the beginning of Islam and was then abrogated; ﴿إِلَّا﴾ but ﴿أَنْ تَفْعَلُوا إِلَى أَوْلِيَائِكُمْ مَعْرُوفًا﴾ by a bequest, which is permitted; ﴿كَانَ ذَلِكَ﴾ i.e. the abrogation of inheritance by faith and emigration through the inheritance of blood relatives ﴿فِي الْكِتَابِ مَسْطُورًا﴾. What is meant by «the Book» in both places is the Preserved Tablet.

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿وَ﴾ mention ﴿إِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ مِيثَاقَهُمْ﴾ when they were brought out of Adam's loins like dharr — the plural of dharra, which is the smallest ant — ﴿وَمِنْكَ وَمِنْ نُوحٍ وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَى وَعِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ﴾ that they should worship Allah and call to His worship; the mention of the five is a conjoining of the particular to the general; ﴿وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُمْ مِيثَاقًا غَلِيظًا﴾ a strong one, to fulfil what they were charged with — it is the oath by Allah the Exalted. Then He took the covenant

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿لِيَسْأَلَ﴾ Allah ﴿الصَّادِقِينَ عَنْ صِدْقِهِمْ﴾ in conveying the message, as a rebuke to those who disbelieved in them; ﴿وَأَعَدَّ﴾ He, exalted is He, ﴿لِلْكَافِرِينَ﴾ in them ﴿عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا﴾ painful; it is conjoined to أَخَذْنَا.

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَاءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌ﴾ of the unbelievers, formed into confederate parties, in the days of digging the Trench, ﴿فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا وَجُنُودًا لَمْ تَرَوْهَا﴾ of angels; ﴿وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ with tāʾ: of digging the Trench; and with yāʾ: of the idolaters' forming of parties, ﴿بَصِيرًا﴾

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿إِذْ جَاءُوكُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ﴾ from the top of the valley and its bottom, from the east and the west, ﴿وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ الْأَبْصَارُ﴾ turned from everything else to their enemy on every side, ﴿وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ﴾ the plural of ḥanjara, which is the end of the throat, from the intensity of fear, ﴿وَتَظُنُّونَ بِاللَّهِ الظُّنُونَا﴾ the varying ones, of victory and of despair.

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿هُنَالِكَ ابْتُلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ were tested, so that the sincere might be distinguished from the others, ﴿وَزُلْزِلُوا﴾ were shaken ﴿زِلْزَالًا شَدِيدًا﴾ from the intensity of terror.

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿وَ﴾ mention ﴿إِذْ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ﴾ weakness of conviction: ﴿مَا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ﴾ of victory ﴿إِلَّا غُرُورًا﴾ falsehood.

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿وَإِذْ قَالَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ﴾ i.e. the hypocrites, ﴿يَا أَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ﴾ — it is the land of Medina; it is a diptote (not given nunation) because of being a proper name and having the pattern of a verb — ﴿لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ﴾ with ḍamma on the mīm and with fatḥa, i.e. no staying and no standing-place, ﴿فَارْجِعُوا﴾ to your homes in Medina — they had gone out with the Prophet ﷺ to Salʿ, a mountain outside Medina, to fight. ﴿وَيَسْتَأْذِنُ فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمُ النَّبِيَّ﴾ to go back, ﴿يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوْرَةٌ﴾ unfortified, feared for. He, exalted is He, said: ﴿وَمَا هِيَ بِعَوْرَةٍ إِنْ﴾ not ﴿يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِرَارًا﴾ from the fighting.

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿وَلَوْ دُخِلَتْ﴾ i.e. Medina ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَقْطَارِهَا﴾ its sides, ﴿ثُمَّ سُئِلُوا﴾ i.e. those entering asked them ﴿الْفِتْنَةَ﴾ idolatry, ﴿لَآتَوْهَا﴾ with and without the long vowel (madd and qaṣr), i.e. they would have given it and done it, ﴿وَمَا تَلَبَّثُوا بِهَا إِلَّا يَسِيرًا﴾

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ كَانُوا عَاهَدُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ قَبْلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ الْأَدْبَارَ وَكَانَ عَهْدُ اللَّهِ مَسْئُولًا﴾ about its fulfilment.

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿قُلْ لَنْ يَنْفَعَكُمُ الْفِرَارُ إِنْ فَرَرْتُمْ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ أَوِ الْقَتْلِ وَإِذًا﴾ if you flee, ﴿لَا تُمَتَّعُونَ﴾ in this world after your flight ﴿إِلَّا قَلِيلًا﴾ the rest of your appointed terms.

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿قُلْ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَعْصِمُكُمْ﴾ protects you ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ سُوءًا﴾ destruction and defeat, ﴿أَوْ﴾ afflicts you with evil if ﴿أَرَادَ﴾ Allah ﴿بِكُمْ رَحْمَةً﴾ good? ﴿وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. other than Him ﴿وَلِيًّا﴾ to benefit them ﴿وَلَا نَصِيرًا﴾ to ward off harm from them.

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُعَوِّقِينَ﴾ those who hold back [others] ﴿مِنْكُمْ وَالْقَائِلِينَ لِإِخْوَانِهِمْ هَلُمَّ﴾ come ﴿إِلَيْنَا وَلَا يَأْتُونَ الْبَأْسَ﴾ the fighting ﴿إِلَّا قَلِيلًا﴾ for show and reputation,

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿أَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ with help — the plural of shaḥīḥ, and it is the ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of يَأْتُونَ; ﴿فَإِذَا جَاءَ الْخَوْفُ رَأَيْتَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كَالَّذِي﴾ like the look, or like the rolling, of one who ﴿يُغْشَى عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ﴾ i.e. its throes; ﴿فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ الْخَوْفُ﴾ and the spoils have been gathered, ﴿سَلَقُوكُمْ﴾ they hurt you or strike you ﴿بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى الْخَيْرِ﴾ i.e. the spoils, demanding them; ﴿أُولَئِكَ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا﴾ in reality, ﴿فَأَحْبَطَ اللَّهُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ﴾ annulment ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا﴾ by His will.

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿يَحْسَبُونَ الْأَحْزَابَ﴾ of the unbelievers ﴿لَمْ يَذْهَبُوا﴾ to Mecca, because of their fear of them; ﴿وَإِنْ يَأْتِ الْأَحْزَابُ﴾ another time, ﴿يَوَدُّوا﴾ they would wish ﴿لَوْ أَنَّهُمْ بَادُونَ فِي الْأَعْرَابِ﴾ i.e. were in the desert, ﴿يَسْأَلُونَ عَنْ أَنْبَائِكُمْ﴾ your news with the unbelievers; ﴿وَلَوْ كَانُوا فِيكُمْ﴾ this time ﴿مَا قَاتَلُوا إِلَّا قَلِيلًا﴾ for show and for fear of reproach.

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ إِسْوَةٌ﴾ with kasra on the hamza and with ḍamma [أُسْوَةٌ] ﴿حَسَنَةٌ﴾ following his example in fighting and standing firm in its places, ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ a badal (substitute) from لَكُمْ, ﴿كَانَ يَرْجُو اللَّهَ﴾ fears Him ﴿وَالْيَوْمَ الْآخِرَ وَذَكَرَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا﴾ — unlike one who is not so.

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿وَلَمَّا رَأَى الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْأَحْزَابَ﴾ of the unbelievers, ﴿قَالُوا هَذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ﴾ of trial and victory, ﴿وَصَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ﴾ in the promise; ﴿وَمَا زَادَهُمْ﴾ that ﴿إِلَّا إِيمَانًا﴾ belief in Allah's promise ﴿وَتَسْلِيمًا﴾ to His command.

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوا مَا عَاهَدُوا اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ﴾ of standing firm with the Prophet ﷺ; ﴿فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَضَى نَحْبَهُ﴾ died or was killed in the way of Allah, ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْتَظِرُ﴾ that, ﴿وَمَا بَدَّلُوا تَبْدِيلًا﴾ in the covenant — and they are unlike the state of the hypocrites —

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿لِيَجْزِيَ اللَّهُ الصَّادِقِينَ بِصِدْقِهِمْ وَيُعَذِّبَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ إِنْ شَاءَ﴾ by making them die in their hypocrisy, ﴿أَوْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا﴾ to whoever repents, ﴿رَحِيمًا﴾ to him.

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿وَرَدَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ i.e. the Confederates ﴿بِغَيْظِهِمْ لَمْ يَنَالُوا خَيْرًا﴾ their aim of victory over the believers; ﴿وَكَفَى اللَّهُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الْقِتَالَ﴾ through the wind and the angels; ﴿وَكَانَ اللَّهُ قَوِيًّا﴾ in bringing into being what He wills, ﴿عَزِيزًا﴾ prevailing over His affair.

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿وَأَنْزَلَ الَّذِينَ ظَاهَرُوهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ﴾ i.e. Qurayẓa ﴿مِنْ صَيَاصِيهِمْ﴾ their fortresses — the plural of ṣīṣiya, which is that by which one fortifies oneself — ﴿وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الرُّعْبَ﴾ fear; ﴿فَرِيقًا تَقْتُلُونَ﴾ of them, namely the fighting men, ﴿وَتَأْسِرُونَ فَرِيقًا﴾ of them, i.e. the offspring.

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿وَأَوْرَثَكُمْ أَرْضَهُمْ وَدِيَارَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ وَأَرْضًا لَمْ تَطَئُوهَا﴾ yet — it is Khaybar, taken after Qurayẓa; ﴿وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرًا﴾

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لِأَزْوَاجِكَ﴾ — they were nine, and they had asked him for some of the adornment of this world which he did not have — ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيْنَ أُمَتِّعْكُنَّ﴾ i.e. the gift of divorce (mutʿat al-ṭalāq), ﴿وَأُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا﴾ divorce you without harm.

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿وَإِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ﴾ i.e. the Garden, ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْمُحْسِنَاتِ مِنْكُنَّ﴾ by desiring the Hereafter ﴿أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا﴾ i.e. the Garden. So they chose the Hereafter over this world.

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿يَا نِسَاءَ النَّبِيِّ مَنْ يَأْتِ مِنْكُنَّ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُبَيَّنَةٍ﴾ with fatḥa on the yāʾ and with kasra [مُبَيِّنَةٍ], i.e. made clear, or it is clear, ﴿يُضَاعَفْ﴾ — and in one reading [يُضَعَّفْ] with doubling, and in another [نُضَعِّفْ] with nūn together with it and the accusative of الْعَذَاب — ﴿لَهَا الْعَذَابُ ضِعْفَيْنِ﴾ twice the punishment of others, i.e. double it; ﴿وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا﴾

celaleyn:31-31.t: ﴿وَمَنْ يَقْنُتْ﴾ obeys ﴿مِنْكُنَّ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا نُؤْتِهَا أَجْرَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ﴾ i.e. twice the reward of other women — and in one reading with the dotted-below letter (yāʾ) in تَعْمَلْ and نُؤْتِهَا — ﴿وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهَا رِزْقًا كَرِيمًا﴾ in the Garden, in addition.

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿يَا نِسَاءَ النَّبِيِّ لَسْتُنَّ كَأَحَدٍ﴾ like any group ﴿مِنَ النِّسَاءِ إِنِ اتَّقَيْتُنَّ﴾ Allah, for you are greater; ﴿فَلَا تَخْضَعْنَ بِالْقَوْلِ﴾ to men, ﴿فَيَطْمَعَ الَّذِي فِي قَلْبِهِ مَرَضٌ﴾ hypocrisy, ﴿وَقُلْنَ قَوْلًا مَعْرُوفًا﴾ without softness.

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿وَقِرْنَ﴾ with kasra on the qāf and with fatḥa [وَقَرْنَ] ﴿فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ﴾ from al-qarār (staying); its underlying form is iqrirna, with kasra on the rāʾ and with fatḥa, from qarartu with fatḥa on the rāʾ and with kasra; the vowel of the rāʾ was transferred to the qāf, and it [the rāʾ] was dropped together with the connective hamza (hamzat al-waṣl). ﴿وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ﴾ by dropping one of the two tāʾs of its underlying form, ﴿تَبَرُّجَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ الْأُولَى﴾ i.e. what was before Islam: women displaying their charms to men; the displaying after Islam is mentioned in the verse {وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا}. ﴿وَأَقِمْنَ الصَّلَوةَ وَآتِينَ الزَّكَوةَ وَأَطِعْنَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ﴾ sin, O ﴿أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ﴾ i.e. wives of the Prophet ﷺ, ﴿وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ﴾ from it ﴿تَطْهِيرًا﴾

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿وَاذْكُرْنَ مَا يُتْلَى فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ﴾ the Qurʾān, ﴿وَالْحِكْمَةِ﴾ the Sunna; ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ لَطِيفًا﴾ to His friends, ﴿خَبِيرًا﴾ of all His creation.

celaleyn:35-35.t: ﴿إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْقَانِتِينَ وَالْقَانِتَاتِ﴾ the obedient women, ﴿وَالصَّادِقِينَ وَالصَّادِقَاتِ﴾ in faith, ﴿وَالصَّابِرِينَ وَالصَّابِرَاتِ﴾ in acts of obedience, ﴿وَالْخَاشِعِينَ﴾ the humble ﴿وَالْخَاشِعَاتِ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقَاتِ وَالصَّائِمِينَ وَالصَّائِمَاتِ وَالْحَافِظِينَ فُرُوجَهُمْ وَالْحَافِظَاتِ﴾ from what is unlawful, ﴿وَالذَّاكِرِينَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَالذَّاكِرَاتِ أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةً﴾ for acts of disobedience ﴿وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا﴾ for acts of obedience.

celaleyn:36-36.t: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَمْرًا أَنْ تَكُونَ﴾ with tāʾ and with yāʾ [يَكُونَ] ﴿لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ﴾ i.e. the choice ﴿مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ﴾ contrary to the command of Allah and His Messenger. It was revealed concerning ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jaḥsh and his sister Zaynab: the Prophet ﷺ asked for her hand, meaning [her] for Zayd ibn Ḥāritha; they disliked that when they learned of it, because they had thought beforehand that the Prophet ﷺ was asking for her hand for himself; then they consented because of the verse. ﴿وَمَنْ يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَالًا مُبِينًا﴾ clear. So the Prophet ﷺ married her to Zayd. Then, after a time, his gaze fell upon her, and love for her entered his heart, and dislike of her entered Zayd's heart. Then he [Zayd] said to the Prophet ﷺ: I want to part from her; and he said: «Keep your wife to yourself», as He, exalted is He, said:

celaleyn:37-37.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾ in the accusative through «mention» (udhkur), ﴿تَقُولُ لِلَّذِي أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ﴾ with Islam ﴿وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ﴾ by setting him free — he is Zayd ibn Ḥāritha; he had been among the captives of the Jāhiliyya; the Messenger of Allah ﷺ bought him before the mission, set him free and adopted him — ﴿أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَاتَّقِ اللَّهَ﴾ in the matter of divorcing her, ﴿وَتُخْفِي فِي نَفْسِكَ مَا اللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ﴾ disclosing — of your love for her, and that if Zayd parted from her you would marry her — ﴿وَتَخْشَى النَّاسَ﴾ that they would say: he married his son's wife; ﴿وَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَنْ تَخْشَاهُ﴾ in everything — and marry her, and do not mind what people say. Then Zayd divorced her and her waiting period (ʿidda) ended. He, exalted is He, said: ﴿فَلَمَّا قَضَى زَيْدٌ مِنْهَا وَطَرًا﴾ need, ﴿زَوَّجْنَاكَهَا﴾ — so the Prophet ﷺ went in to her without permission [of a guardian], and fed the Muslims bread and meat to their fill — ﴿لِكَيْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌ فِي أَزْوَاجِ أَدْعِيَائِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًا وَكَانَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ﴾ what He decrees ﴿مَفْعُولًا﴾

celaleyn:38-38.t: ﴿مَا كَانَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ مِنْ حَرَجٍ فِيمَا فَرَضَ﴾ made lawful ﴿اللَّهُ لَهُ سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. like the way of Allah — so it is accusative by removal of the preposition — ﴿فِي الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ among the prophets, that there is no blame on them in that, as an ease for them in marriage; ﴿وَكَانَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ﴾ His doing ﴿قَدَرًا مَقْدُورًا﴾ decreed,

celaleyn:39-39.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of الَّذِينَ before it, ﴿يُبَلِّغُونَ رِسَالَاتِ اللَّهِ وَيَخْشَوْنَهُ وَلَا يَخْشَوْنَ أَحَدًا إِلَّا اللَّهَ﴾ so they do not fear people's talk about what Allah has made lawful for them; ﴿وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ حَسِيبًا﴾ as a keeper of the deeds of His creation and the one who calls them to account.

celaleyn:40-40.t: ﴿مَا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبَا أَحَدٍ مِنْ رِجَالِكُمْ﴾ so he is not the father of Zayd, i.e. his parent, and so marrying his wife Zaynab is not unlawful for him; ﴿وَلَكِنْ﴾ he was ﴿رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَخَاتِمَ النَّبِيِّينَ﴾ so he will have no grown son after him who would be a prophet — and in one reading [وَخَاتَمَ] with fatḥa on the tāʾ, like the instrument of sealing, i.e. by him they were sealed; ﴿وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا﴾ including that there is no prophet after him; and when the master Jesus descends, he will judge by his [Muḥammad's] Sacred Law.

celaleyn:41-41.t: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:42-42.t: ﴿وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا﴾ the beginning of the day and its end.

celaleyn:43-43.t: ﴿هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ i.e. has mercy on you, ﴿وَمَلَائِكَتُهُ﴾ i.e. they ask forgiveness for you, ﴿لِيُخْرِجَكُمْ﴾ that He may continue to bring you out ﴿مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ﴾ i.e. unbelief ﴿إِلَى النُّورِ﴾ i.e. faith; ﴿وَكَانَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَحِيمًا﴾.

celaleyn:44-44.t: ﴿تَحِيَّتُهُمْ﴾ from Him, exalted is He, ﴿يَوْمَ يَلْقَوْنَهُ سَلَامٌ﴾ by the tongue of the angels; ﴿وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَرِيمًا﴾ it is the Garden.

celaleyn:45-45.t: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا﴾ over those to whom you have been sent, ﴿وَمُبَشِّرًا﴾ to those who believe you, of the Garden, ﴿وَنَذِيرًا﴾ warning those who deny you of the Fire,

celaleyn:46-46.t: ﴿وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ to His obedience ﴿بِإِذْنِهِ﴾ by His command, ﴿وَسِرَاجًا مُنِيرًا﴾ i.e. like it in being guided by him.

celaleyn:47-47.t: ﴿وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ فَضْلًا كَبِيرًا﴾ it is the Garden.

celaleyn:48-48.t: ﴿وَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ﴾ in what contradicts your Sacred Law, ﴿وَدَعْ﴾ leave ﴿أَذَاهُمْ﴾ do not retaliate against them for it until you are given a command concerning them; ﴿وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ for He suffices you; ﴿وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا﴾ as one to whom [matters] are entrusted.

celaleyn:49-49.t: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا نَكَحْتُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَمَسُّوهُنَّ﴾ — in one reading [تُمَاسُّوهُنَّ] — i.e. have intercourse with them, ﴿فَمَا لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ عِدَّةٍ تَعْتَدُّونَهَا﴾ count, by menstrual cycles and otherwise; ﴿فَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ﴾ give them something to enjoy, i.e. if no dowries have been named for them; otherwise they have half of what was named only — Ibn ʿAbbās said this, and al-Shāfiʿī holds it; ﴿وَسَرِّحُوهُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا﴾ let them go their way without harm.

celaleyn:50-50.t: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِنَّا أَحْلَلْنَا لَكَ أَزْوَاجَكَ اللَّاتِي آتَيْتَ أُجُورَهُنَّ﴾ their dowries, ﴿وَمَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ مِمَّا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ﴾ from the unbelievers by capture, like Ṣafiyya and Juwayriya, ﴿وَبَنَاتِ عَمِّكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمَّاتِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَالِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَالَاتِكَ اللَّاتِي هَاجَرْنَ مَعَكَ﴾ unlike those who did not emigrate, ﴿وَامْرَأَةً مُؤْمِنَةً إِنْ وَهَبَتْ نَفْسَهَا لِلنَّبِيِّ إِنْ أَرَادَ النَّبِيُّ أَنْ يَسْتَنْكِحَهَا﴾ seek to marry her without a dowry — ﴿خَالِصَةً لَكَ مِنْ دُونِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ marriage by the word «gift» (hiba) without a dowry. ﴿قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا فَرَضْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ i.e. the believers ﴿فِي أَزْوَاجِهِمْ﴾ of rulings: that they not exceed four wives, and not marry except with a guardian, witnesses and a dowry, ﴿وَ﴾ in ﴿مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ﴾ of slave-women, by purchase and otherwise: that the slave-woman be one lawful to her owner, such as a woman of the People of the Book, unlike a Magian or an idolatress, and that she be made to wait to establish she is not pregnant (istibrāʾ) before intercourse; ﴿لِكَيْلَا﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes that, ﴿يَكُونَ عَلَيْكَ حَرَجٌ﴾ constraint in marriage; ﴿وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا﴾ in what is hard to guard against, ﴿رَحِيمًا﴾ in granting ease in that.

celaleyn:51-51.t: ﴿تُرْجِئُ﴾ with hamza, and with yāʾ in its place [تُرْجِي]: you defer ﴿مَنْ تَشَاءُ مِنْهُنَّ﴾ i.e. your wives, from her turn, ﴿وَتُؤْوِي﴾ take ﴿إِلَيْكَ مَنْ تَشَاءُ﴾ of them, and go to her; ﴿وَمَنِ ابْتَغَيْتَ﴾ seek ﴿مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ﴾ from the division [of turns], ﴿فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَ﴾ in seeking her and taking her to you — he was given the choice in that after the division [of turns] had been obligatory on him. ﴿ذَلِكَ﴾ choice is ﴿أَدْنَى﴾ nearer to ﴿أَنْ تَقَرَّ أَعْيُنُهُنَّ وَلَا يَحْزَنَّ وَيَرْضَيْنَ بِمَا آتَيْتَهُنَّ﴾ what has been mentioned of what is left to choice — ﴿كُلُّهُنَّ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the fāʿil (agent) in يَرْضَيْنَ; ﴿وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ﴾ concerning women and inclining to some of them; We have only given you the choice concerning them to make easy for you all that you wish; ﴿وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيمًا﴾ of His creation, ﴿حَلِيمًا﴾ in [refraining from] punishing them.

celaleyn:52-52.t: ﴿لَا تَحِلُّ﴾ with tāʾ and with yāʾ [يَحِلُّ] ﴿لَكَ النِّسَاءُ مِنْ بَعْدُ﴾ after the nine who chose you, ﴿وَلَا أَنْ تَبَدَّلَ﴾ by dropping one of the two tāʾs of the underlying form ﴿بِهِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَاجٍ﴾ by divorcing them or some of them and marrying in place of the one you divorced, ﴿وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكَ حُسْنُهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ﴾ of slave-women, who are lawful for you — and after them he ﷺ came to own Māriya, who bore him Ibrāhīm, who died in his lifetime; ﴿وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ رَقِيبًا﴾ a keeper.

celaleyn:53-53.t: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتَ النَّبِيِّ إِلَّا أَنْ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ﴾ to enter, by invitation ﴿إِلَى طَعَامٍ﴾ and then enter, ﴿غَيْرَ نَاظِرِينَ﴾ waiting for ﴿إِنَاهُ﴾ its being cooked — a maṣdar (verbal noun) of anā yanī; ﴿وَلَكِنْ إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ فَادْخُلُوا فَإِذَا طَعِمْتُمْ فَانْتَشِرُوا وَلَا﴾ stay ﴿مُسْتَأْنِسِينَ لِحَدِيثٍ﴾ with one another; ﴿إِنَّ ذَلِكُمْ﴾ staying ﴿كَانَ يُؤْذِي النَّبِيَّ فَيَسْتَحْيِي مِنْكُمْ﴾ to send you out, ﴿وَاللَّهُ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ﴾ to send you out, i.e. He does not leave off making it clear — and it has been read [يَسْتَحِي] with a single yāʾ. ﴿وَإِذَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُنَّ﴾ i.e. the wives of the Prophet ﷺ ﴿مَتَاعًا فَاسْأَلُوهُنَّ مِنْ وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ﴾ a screen; ﴿ذَلِكُمْ أَطْهَرُ لِقُلُوبِكُمْ وَقُلُوبِهِنَّ﴾ from suspicious thoughts; ﴿وَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَنْ تُؤْذُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ﴾ in anything, ﴿وَلَا أَنْ تَنْكِحُوا أَزْوَاجَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ أَبَدًا إِنَّ ذَلِكُمْ كَانَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ﴾ a sin ﴿عَظِيمًا﴾

celaleyn:54-54.t: ﴿إِنْ تُبْدُوا شَيْئًا أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ﴾ concerning marrying them after him, ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا﴾ and He will requite you for it.

celaleyn:55-55.t: ﴿لَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِنَّ فِي آبَائِهِنَّ وَلَا أَبْنَائِهِنَّ وَلَا إِخْوَانِهِنَّ وَلَا أَبْنَاءِ إِخْوَانِهِنَّ وَلَا أَبْنَاءِ أَخَوَاتِهِنَّ وَلَا نِسَائِهِنَّ﴾ i.e. the believing women, ﴿وَلَا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُنَّ﴾ of slave-women and slaves, that they see them and speak to them without a screen; ﴿وَاتَّقِينَ اللَّهَ﴾ in what you have been commanded; ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدًا﴾ nothing is hidden from Him.

celaleyn:56-56.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ﴾ Muḥammad ﷺ; ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا﴾ i.e. say: «O Allah, bless Muḥammad and grant him peace» (Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa-sallim).

celaleyn:57-57.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ﴾ — they are the unbelievers, who ascribe to Allah what He is far above, such as a child and a partner, and deny His Messenger — ﴿لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ﴾ has banished them, ﴿وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا مُهِينًا﴾ involving humiliation, and it is the Fire.

celaleyn:58-58.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِغَيْرِ مَا اكْتَسَبُوا﴾ accuse them of what they did not do, ﴿فَقَدِ احْتَمَلُوا بُهْتَانًا﴾ have taken on a lie ﴿وَإِثْمًا مُبِينًا﴾ clear.

celaleyn:59-59.t: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لِأَزْوَاجِكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ وَنِسَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يُدْنِينَ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ جَلَابِيبِهِنَّ﴾ the plural of jilbāb, which is the wrap in which a woman envelops herself, i.e. let them let down some of it over their faces when they go out for their needs, except for one eye; ﴿ذَلِكَ أَدْنَى﴾ nearer to ﴿أَنْ يُعْرَفْنَ﴾ as free women, ﴿فَلَا يُؤْذَيْنَ﴾ by being accosted — unlike slave-women, who do not cover their faces, and the hypocrites used to accost them; ﴿وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا﴾ of their past neglect of covering, ﴿رَحِيمًا﴾ to them, since He has covered them.

celaleyn:60-60.t: ﴿لَئِنْ﴾ the lām of oath ﴿لَمْ يَنْتَهِ الْمُنَافِقُونَ﴾ from their hypocrisy, ﴿وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ﴾ of fornication, ﴿وَالْمُرْجِفُونَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ﴾ the believers, by saying: the enemy has come upon you, and your raiding parties have been killed or defeated, ﴿لَنُغْرِيَنَّكَ بِهِمْ﴾ We shall surely give you power over them; ﴿ثُمَّ لَا يُجَاوِرُونَكَ﴾ live alongside you ﴿فِيهَا إِلَّا قَلِيلًا﴾ then they will leave,

celaleyn:61-61.t: ﴿مَلْعُونِينَ﴾ banished from mercy; ﴿أَيْنَمَا ثُقِفُوا﴾ are found, ﴿أُخِذُوا وَقُتِّلُوا تَقْتِيلًا﴾ i.e. the ruling concerning them is this, by way of commanding it.
